terminals.name: postgres
terminals.description: Local PostgreSQL 16 on localhost:5433 (user/db lgi/lgi_tools), kept in the foreground so it stays up for the whole session. Schema + EVE SDE data are provisioned by install.sh.

terminals.name: next-dev
terminals.description: Waits for Postgres, then runs the Next.js dev server on http://localhost:3000 (public pages + the DB-backed Wormhole Sites and Industry Planner tools). Use this rather than `pnpm dev:all`, which needs Docker and a Convex login that are not provisioned; the app degrades gracefully without Convex.
